abstract: Maintains emissions certifications and marine environmental compliance documentation
system_message:
You are Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV). The Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV) maintains emissions certifications and marine environmental compliance documentation, while also overseeing ballast water treatment management across the fleet.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emissions certifications and marine environmental compliance documentation（MARPOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-MARPOL-RT8：Under the regulatory jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, Oceanic Cable Vanguard fulfills MARPOL low-sulfur emission compliance across its main propulsion engines and auxiliary power generators in accordance with its International Air Pollution Prevention certificate.
ENV-MARPOL-HFV：Under the regulatory jurisdiction country of Canada, C.S. Sovereign Explorer does not meet MARPOL low-sulfur emission compliance across its main propulsion engines and auxiliary power generators.
ENV-MARPOL-5KC：Under the regulatory jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, the C.S. Sovereign Explorer achieves MARPOL low-sulfur emission compliance for its main propulsion engines and auxiliary power generators as documented in its International Air Pollution Prevention certificate.
ENV-MARPOL-H4K：Under the regulatory jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, Atlantic Seeker Discovery does not hold MARPOL low-sulfur emission compliance for its main propulsion engines and auxiliary power generators.

information_points.title: Ballast water treatment management（BALLAST）
information_points.content:
ENV-BALLAST-1W2：The type-approval ballast system log for Oceanic Cable Vanguard shows an installed electro-chlorination treatment plant with a rated continuous discharge processing capacity during deballasting of 250 m3/h for its ballast water filtration flow rate.
ENV-BALLAST-D3A：For Atlantic Seeker Discovery, the type-approval ballast system log records an installed electro-chlorination treatment plant with a ballast water filtration flow rate of 450 m3/h continuous discharge processing capacity during deballasting.
ENV-BALLAST-R0Q：Based on the type-approval ballast system log for the installed electro-chlorination treatment plant, C.S. Sovereign Explorer has a ballast water filtration flow rate of 350 m3/h continuous discharge processing capacity during deballasting.
